plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. HEADING AS PRINTED: the map page heads 'Geology map for 2026-2027' followed by 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' The map page does NOT print a 'This pathway map is for catalog year ...' sentence; the 2026-2027 catalog year is taken from the map heading and the program page's 2026-2027 catalog-year selection. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated, except the small closed sets named in these notes where the browser verified them. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. This plan transcribes the only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Geology / Associate in Science for Transfer / 60-66.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full. The map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-17 / 15 / 15-18 and a plan total of 60-66.5 units. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4) and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4); Term 4 'Area 5B : Biological Sciences' (3-5) and 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. MATH C2211, GEOL B10 and GEOL B10L are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. MATH C2211, GEOL B10L, MATH C2221, GEOL B11L, CHEM B1A and CHEM B1B carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. No 'Major List' slot appears on this map. Small closed dropdown sets verified by the browser on these maps: Area 1A (EMLS B1A, EMLS B1AL, ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000E); Area 1C (COMM C1000 only); Area 1B (COMM B15, ENGL C1001, ENGL C1003, HIST B9, PHIL B8, PHIL B9); Area 6 (ETHN B30B, ETHN B35, HIST B30B, PHIL B35); Area 5B (ANTH C1001, BIOL B3A, BIOL B3B, BIOL B8, BIOL C1000, BIOL B16, BIOL B18, BIOL B32, BIOL B33, CRPS B5, FORE B8, HEIT B60, PSYC B1B). Per the standing slot convention these options are named here only and the slots are recorded unselected.
